name: ROTOR RPM
description: Rotor RPM (NR) is outside normal range. NR LOW: 97% or less (steady light, slow beep, mutable). NR HIGH: 107.5% up to 112% (flashing light, fast beep, mutable) or 112%+ (flashing light, fast beep, not mutable).

procedure.text: 2. Collective lever — Adjust as necessary to maintain NR within normal range
If NR is also indicated below both N2 values, suspect an NR indication system failure. In this case maintain torque above 10% to keep N2 and Rotor RPM matched.

Main rotor lead-lag resonance may occur in the 60-68% rotor RPM range. Any stimulation of lead-lag oscillation in this range may severely damage the main rotor blades — maintain the cyclic stick in neutral position and the collective in full down position.

references: FLM EC135 T3H Sect. 3.11.1 (Helionix Step 3.5, 3 MFD)
